summary: Cellectar Biosciences is conducting a registered direct offering of 1,618,053 shares of common stock at $2.65 per share, along with a concurrent private placement of additional shares, prefunded warrants, and warrants exercisable at $2.65. The last sale price on May 4, 2026, was $2.83, implying a modest discount. The company is raising proceeds expected to be approximately $3.94 million after placement agent fees. The filing is a routine capital raise under a shelf registration, not a special situation. It does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other special-situations event. The offering is a plain-vanilla equity financing with no unusual structural features.
